production.direction_en: The river city at dusk. Beneath its bridges, drainage mouths breathe cold air. Chalk arrows mark one of them. At the marked mouth, two Red Vial scouts sit bound back to back, alive, a gray seven-notched seal pressed on each collar.
production.music_direction_en: bgm_road (river city at dusk, distant crowd) → bgm_tension at the bound scouts

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: Someone marked that tunnel. Neat arrows. Harbor knots.

commands.speaker: kera_voss
commands.text: The Undercity. Everything the city does not want to see goes down there. Including my Guild.

commands.speaker: kera_voss
commands.text: Gray wax on Guild scouts, and the scouts still breathing. Someone is hunting my Guild's hunters.

commands.speaker: mahmut
commands.text: Stay close below. The dark down there is not like the forest.

commands.speaker: fadyme
commands.text: I know. The forest at least whispered.
